subject: Penetrate HMS Download Service on 117.169.127.47:8080
description:
Target: 117.169.127.47:8080 - HMS Download Service (load balancer/proxy)
Key findings so far:
- 302 redirects expose 11+ internal IPs (39.134.x.x, 39.135.x.x, 117.169.120.x)
- PUT/DELETE methods return 500
- Paths without extensions → 302 redirect with HMS params appended
- Paths with extensions → mostly 302 redirect, some 404 (.m3u8, .html)
- Query params merged with defaults (icpid, from, popid, hms_devid, prioritypopid, vqe)
